concerns.text: FR-002 still reads 'scaffold-based split with [deferred] of the data allocated to training and [deferred] each to validation and test sets'. FR-013 and Constitution Principle VI both mandate a fixed 80/10/10 split; the placeholder directly contradicts them and leaves the split ratios unmeasurable. Restore explicit 80/10/10. (Prior concern, unresolved.)

Scenario 3 still says 'selected as one of the top [deferred] highest FQY values of the test set'. The placeholder prevents reproducible instantiation of the test input and is inconsistent with the spec's own rule that only empirical measurements are deferred, not selection rules. Replace with a concrete rule (e.g., top-5% or fixed top-N). (Prior concern, unresolved.)

Two different interpretability pass thresholds coexist without reconciliation: US-3 Scenario 3 requires 'at least 3 of the top 5 substructures' to match reference motifs for a single high-FQY molecule, while SC-005 requires '≥60% overlap (at least 12 of the 20 substructures)' on the top-20 aggregate. State explicitly that these are distinct checks (per-molecule spot check vs aggregate enrichment) or unify them; as written a reader cannot tell which governs pass/fail.
FR-003 says '≤5 million parameters' while the Assumptions section says 'a GNN with <5 M parameters'. Minor boundary-condition mismatch (≤ vs <); align wording.
